text:
**False as a general claim—with an important qualification.**

According to [NASA](https://www.nasa.gov/vision/space/workinginspace/great_wall.html), the Great Wall is **generally not visible to the naked eye from low Earth orbit**, and it cannot be seen from the Moon. Despite its length, its narrow width and similarity in color to the surrounding terrain make it difficult to distinguish.

**Nuance:** Some astronauts have reported spotting sections from low orbit under exceptionally favorable conditions. So the familiar claim is misleading, but saying it is *never* visible from anywhere in space would also be too absolute.
